coverage: CATCH-UP covering TWO missed sessions: Wednesday 19 August and Thursday 20 August, both now complete in Asia and the US. The prior brief covered through Tuesday 18 August. Prices and the release calendar were fetched deterministically in code; six research agents ran in parallel for the narrative.
tldr: THE MASTER CATALYST OF THE WEEK: the US Treasury doubled its long-end debt-buyback size on Wednesday after the 30-year yield hit a post-2007 high (~5.33%) — that single move threads through the gold/silver breakout, the KOSPI round trip, and the Bitcoin surge. This is a real, confirmed breakout (GLD +3.84%, SLV +4.47%, GDX +9.42% Wed), unlike the futures-roll false breakout corrected two runs ago.

YOUR LEVERED SILVER/MINERS POSITION HAD A GOOD TWO SESSIONS: silver ETF +4.47% then +2.75%, gold miners GDX +9.42% then +2.59%, with the structural 6th-straight-annual silver deficit underneath. But Thursday's deceleration (miners cooling while metals kept grinding higher) shows the equity-market risk-off is now capping miner beta even as the metals themselves stay bid.

THURSDAY WAS A GENUINE US EQUITY SELLOFF: S&P -0.87%, Nasdaq -1.00%, Dow -1.32%, VIX +7.52% to 16.01 — driven by AI-capex-credibility fears (WSJ flagged ~$3tn of off-balance-sheet AI infrastructure commitments) layered on hawkish Fed cross-currents (a rare 3-of-12 FOMC dissent for a hike, plus Musalem saying he 'won't prejudge' September). Risk-on cut from 0.45 to 0.38.

THE KOSPI'S VIOLENT -5.80%-then-+5.89% ROUND TRIP IS EXPLAINED, not a mystery: Wednesday's crash was the same AI/chip-valuation shock hitting Samsung/SK Hynix hardest; Thursday's near-full reversal was driven by Samsung's >₩100trn and SK Hynix's ~₩40trn buyback announcements. Korea's own flow data confirms it cleanly — retail bought Wednesday's dip, foreign+institutional money bought Thursday's rebound.

WHALE DIVERGENCE OF THE QUARTER: Tepper added Nvidia and cut Micron 41% the same quarter Soros bought NVDA puts and added Micron 7.9x, while Loeb (Third Point) exited both entirely to fund a $533M Warner Bros. Discovery stake — joined there by Einhorn and Soros in an unusual triple-whale convergence. Separately, Ackman (Pershing Square) fully exited Alphabet the same quarter Berkshire added $21.1bn to it.

SGX bank strength (OCBC record profit, DBS/OCBC at all-time highs) is a structural positive for your largest exposure sleeve; the Strait of Hormuz crisis remains unresolved (ADNOC tankers attacked Thursday) and keeps a live risk premium under both oil and gold.

regime.oneLiner: A US Treasury buyback surprise pulled real yields and the dollar down, igniting a genuine gold/silver breakout, but a US equity selloff and hawkish Fed cross-currents cut risk appetite from 0.45 to 0.38 even as idiosyncratic Korea buybacks reversed a violent chip-sector round trip.
